[SWS_TcpIp_00177] ⌈If data is transmitted using an IPv4 socket which is bound to
TCPIP_LOCALADDRID_ANY, then the TcpIp shall use the IP address of the config-
ured local address (TcpIpAddrId), which is of type IPv4 Unicast and assigned to
the EthIfCtrl in the same subnet as the destination IPv4 address as source IP ad-
dress in the IP datagram header. If no matching subnet is found the IPv4 Unicast local
address (TcpIpAddrId) of EthIfCtrl = 0 is selected.⌋()
